In this regard bidder has to submit the declaration ag ainst manufacturer of the offered products/goods in firm’s letter head duly signed and stamped along with MSE(UDYYAM). 5. Mandate Form to be submitted in prescribed format. 6. Performance Security Deposit @ 5 % of the Purchase Order value (including Taxes & Duties) is re quired to be submitted by the successful Bidder in the form of a Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) or Fixed Deposit Receipt from a Scheduled Commercial Bank notified by Reserve Bank of India, in the prescri bed format within thirty days from receipt date of S.O. in favour of METAL AND STEEL FACTORY ISHAPOR E, A UNIT OF YANTRA INDIA LIMITED. (Performance Security Deposit is, however, n ot necessary for contracts valuing up to Rs. 10 lakh. Above Rs. 10 lakh, PSD is mandatory). 7.
